t_advice_summary_textbox.text: choose pink gnomes over blue until the fourth break and choose the longer hatted gnomes for more points. Choose green over orange but later in the game after the fourth break this may be switched up so stay aware to check.

vb_textbox.text: I did the same as the person before me - to begin with choose blue over pink and orange over green, tall over short. However, they thought it did change fairly regularly so if you haven't had any numbers over 10 in a while try switching it up. Although as there is variation anyway between forests...who knows!
